nativeTimeline.detail: The finding location may be the architecture document. This attempt supplied the architecture document as violation.requirement, which only accepts current goal files. Other attempts omitted the required end field.
The proposed payload actually altered the protected generated responsibility section. The guard operated as intended.
The current edit tool allows only executor role.

frozenCandidateSource.observation: Unknown anchor targets are detected in the inventory. The final receipt rejects any status with an unknown linked target and treats the unresolved block as pending.

The per-block record rejects unknown targets before considering the review status. An otherwise valid generic architecture finding still cannot submit while required prose coverage is pending. Optional requirement locations are restricted to the current goal.
Scoped permission checking and generated section preservation apply to writes. The file edit operation is executor-only. A successful review rejection can route to architecture repair.
The registration result binds to the document version. For an eligible review block it can leave blocked after a changed architecture digest. Generated section bodies must remain intact.

sourceOnlyControl.method: Run architectureProseInventory, checkArchitectureProseReceipt and the generated-section guard on the frozen registered Markdown and on an in-memory copy replacing exactly the three target strings. Use the same registered sections and canonical facts.
sourceOnlyControl.limit: Only the two affected rows were exercised in the final receipt validator. The full synthetic receipt therefore stayed pending. This control did not rerun native review, audit, or acceptance and did not edit the frozen snapshot.

interpretation: A real architecture-document traceability defect and a workflow dead end combined here. The frozen executable passed all assessor cases; the reviewer independently identified a real document defect. Normal proof could neither label it nor complete a repair rejection with pending prose blocks. The coordinator's rejected full write was avoidable if it preserved generated content exactly; no paid end-to-end recovery was attempted.
